text.p: These are the leading stories in the Beirut press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-Prime Minister Hariri says social and administrative reform are top priorities.
-Lebanon signs with Ukraine an economic agreement on dual taxation.
-Lebanon hopes to get more U.S. and international support for its reconstruction drive, during the " Friends of Lebanon" meeting to be held in Washington on December 16, Prime Minister Hariri says.

-The five-nation group monitoring a ceasefire understanding in Lebanon said Israeli forces were responsible for shelling two villages on Saturday and deplored the wounding of six civilians in the bombardment.
-The General Confederation of Labour warns the government against increasing prices of gas and electricity.
-Syrian President Assad discussed with Parliament Speaker Berri Lebanese and regional issues.
-Israeli forces infiltrated into Arnoun village just outside Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone.
-Prime Minister Hariri leave to Washington via Paris to attend "Friends of Lebanon" meeting.
